d: The clock is ticking at Orange County Choppers, and the New York State Police tribute bike needs a last-minute rescue. With the rear fender's paintwork ruined and the unveiling ceremony fast approaching, Senior and Junior bring in custom painter Mike Campo to save the build. As Campo works on the intricate gold leafing and blue-and-yellow graphics, Rick Petko and the crew race to complete the final mechanical assembly. Can they pull everything together in time? Watch American Chopper Season 2 Episode 39 for custom motorcycle craftsmanship, high-pressure bike building and an unforgettable…
